title: Returned-Payment Fee Billing on Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
When the most recent returned premium payment on a Rental Property Service Contracts contract was billed back without its returned-payment fee, the fee is fixed under the returned-payment fee basis and billed as one returned-payment fee charge naming that payment.

**Scope.** The basis sets the returned-payment fee only; the returned payment itself is still billed back in full as a returned payment charge. The portfolio discount rate itself is never applied as a percentage to a returned payment, a returned-payment fee or a transfer fee.

## When the fee is billed

A returned-payment fee is not billed until the contract stands in force again, in a status under which premium is billed.

In the same terms: while the contract shows a status under which no premium is billed, its returned-payment fee stays unbilled.

## What the records show afterwards

One returned-payment fee charge in the contract's billing history, dated the day it is billed and naming the returned payment by its payment confirmation number, next to the returned payment charge; the premium balance rises by the fee.

## Invocation: `bill_returned_payment_fee_d229d74e`

**Capability.** One call adds one returned-payment fee charge (charge type `returned_payment_fee`) to the contract's billing history, dated today and naming the returned payment, and raises the contract's premium balance by the fee. The landlord sees the fee on the billing history next to the returned payment and a higher balance.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `bill_returned_payment_fee_d229d74e` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `landlord_contract_id` | the rental property service contract number the returned payment belongs to, as returned by the rental contract lookup for the landlord | identifier text |
| `payment_reference` | the payment confirmation number of the returned payment, as shown on the returned payment charge in the contract's billing history | identifier text |
| `fee_amount` | the returned-payment fee | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` "billed"; `billing_entry_id`, the new fee charge reference; `landlord_contract_id`; `charge_type` "returned_payment_fee"; `payment_reference`, the returned payment named; `amount` in USD with 2 decimal places; and `premium_balance`, the balance owed once the fee is added, in USD with 2 decimal places.

*Hypothetical receipt:* a fee of 25.00 on a returned payment with confirmation number "PAY-5521" returns `status` "billed", `charge_type` "returned_payment_fee", `payment_reference` "PAY-5521", `amount` 25.00 and the premium balance raised by 25.00.
